requirements: Motion Product Portfolio: A collection of work showcasing interactive prototyping, UI animation, kinetic system frameworks, or transition choreographies embedded within shipped software or applications.
Kinetic Physics & Timing: Deep structural mastery of easing curves, interpolation, velocity, spatial tracking, and visual storytelling inside confined mobile environments.
Advanced Tooling Expertise: High proficiency with After Effects, Figma, Principle, ProtoPie, or equivalent interactive prototyping ecosystems.
Technical Communication: Ability to communicate complex motion parameters, frame constraints, and behaviour definitions precisely to engineering partners.
Native familiarity with gesture tracking, system windows, and navigation transitions native to modern Android OS distributions.
Experience building and maintaining code-exportable animation pipelines (e.g., Lottie, custom vector drawables, or native engine transition values) to ensure pixel-perfect deployment.
A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Post-Graduate degree in Animation, Media Arts, Interactive Design, Film/Video Design, or an equivalent technical creative field.
responsibilities: Architect the Kinetic Signature: Define, maintain, and elevate the unified motion language, choreographed transitions, and physics engines across Glance’s mobile surfaces. Your work will span everything from micro-interactions and tactile feedback loops to rich, immersive visual narratives.

Integrate Motion Early: Partner intimately with UX, Visual Design, Product, and Engineering from the initial ideation phase, ensuring that motion is treated as an architectural foundation of the user journey rather than a cosmetic addition at the end of a sprint.

Systematise Repeatable Behaviour: Create reusable, scalable motion principles, interpolation curves, timing guidelines, and asset packages that allow other product teams to scale consistent kinetic behaviour across features and use cases.

Bridge Concept to Code: Build high-fidelity interactive prototypes to test real feel and collaborate directly with front-end Android engineers to translate motion paths into production code without loss of visual fidelity.
Mentor and Inspire: Guide, structure, and educate junior designers within the studio on the principles of UI motion, framing motion as an instrument of clarity and brand expression.

Represent the Studio: Share your insights, workflow methodologies, and Glance’s motion innovation both internally to the larger InMobi organisation and externally within the broader global design community.
